    Over the past year, PAX Gold has fallen 11.8%. Its daily closes ranged from $3,539.71 (November 20, 2026) to $5,541.45 (January 28, 2026) over the last 52 weeks.     About PAX Gold

    PAX Gold is a tokenized-gold asset issued by Paxos. Each PAXG is backed by one fine troy ounce of gold held in professional vaults and is redeemable for that gold.

    Where this PAXG price comes from

    The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (PAXG-USD), Binance (PAXG/USDT) and Kraken (PAXG/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade.
